title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P03: Plan D: plant food / Plan E: music
summary: A mountain of plant food. Then a boombox dance party for the seed.

lines.note: WS: Sam rolls in a wheelbarrow with a huge sack 'PLANT FOOD XXL'.
He tips the wheelbarrow: a mountain buries the mound (dust cloud, thud). Flies buzz; Pip flees the fence.

lines.text: Sam. That's not dinner. That's a mountain.
lines.tts: [deadpan] Sam. That's not dinner. That's a mountain.

lines.text: It smells like a big appetite.
lines.tts: [pinching her nose, nasal] It smells like a big appetite.
lines.note: She pinches her nose (wavy smell lines rise). Sam sniffs... gags. Quick wipe: he has shovelled it away (silent beat).
He drags in a big boombox and slams PLAY: a funky beat. He dances (CMU dance mocap, ~6 s); Pip bobs its head; Layla's needles click in rhythm without her noticing.

lines.text: Feel the beat, little buddy! *Grow* to the beat!
lines.tts: [shouting over loud music, dancing] Feel the beat, little buddy! Grow to the beat!
lines.note: Still dancing; the mound does nothing.

lines.text: Sam. It's a seed. It doesn't have *ears*.
lines.tts: [raising her voice over the music, dry] Sam. It's a seed. It doesn't have ears.

lines.note: He cranks the volume: the boombox shakes, the mound vibrates, Layla's hijab flutters, Pip is blown off the fence. The boombox topples over: 'bwomp', silence.

beats: l4 gap: flies buzz around the mountain; Pip flees the fence.
l7 gap: speed-shovelling montage (dirt flying, a wipe), then he drags the boombox in and slams PLAY.
l8 gap: the dance sequence — Sam dances (mocap), Pip head-bobs, Layla's needles click in rhythm, her foot taps.
